categories.info: Collected to upgrade the Camarader-E perk and unlock the ED-Ecated achievement/trophy.

categories.title: Holotape
categories.info: Holotapes are audio recordings found through the wasteland. They provide lore and details about the world.

categories.title: Skill Book
categories.info: Skill Books permanently raise the corresponding skill by 3 points. The Comprehension perk raises this increase to 4 points.

categories.title: Skill Magazine
categories.info: Skill Magazines are consumable items that raise a skill by 10 points for 60 seconds. The Comprehension perk raises the skill increase to 20, while the Retention perk increases the duration to 3 minutes.

categories.title: Snow Globe
categories.info: Gathered as part of the unmarked quest [Useless Baubles or Fancy Trinkets?](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/mojave-wasteland?locationIds=510014) where each snow globe is worth 2000 caps.

categories.title: Armor
categories.info: Armor raises your Damage Threshold, resulting in less damage from attacks. It degrades with use, and must be repaired with similar items (or anything from the same category with the Jury Rigging perk).

locations.title: Ulysses Log: Y-17.15
locations.description:
**Location:** [Hopeville Missile Base - Loading Station](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/the-divide?locationIds=485290) - Behind the gate, inside a toolbox among the crates and a truck laying on its side.

_One of six Ulysses holotapes that must be collected to complete the **Ulysses' Odyssey** challenge and unlock XP._

locations.title: Ulysses Log: Y-17.21
locations.description:
**Location:** Behind a locked gate that can be unlocked via [Warehouse Stash Key](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/the-divide?locationIds=490792). Once you're through it, the holotape is on a shelf in the corner to your left.

_One of six Ulysses holotapes that must be collected to complete the **Ulysses' Odyssey** challenge and unlock XP._

locations.title: Flash Bang Information

locations.title: Ulysses Log: Y-17.16

locations.title: The Apocalypse
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ulysses' Temple](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/the-divide?locationIds=485294)

**Quest Giver:** Automatically begins after killing or convincing [Ulysses](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/the-divide?locationIds=496184) to stand down, then directing the missiles at NCR or Legion territory (or both!)

**Reward:**
- XP
- +1 point to be spent on any SPECIAL stat
- NCR fame + Legion infamy + Dry Wells can be visited (if Legion is nuked)
- NCR infamy + Legion fame + Long 15 can be visited (if NCR is nuked)
- Boomers fame + Powder Gangers fame (if both are nuked)

locations.title: Futurama Reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

Inside the [Cave of the Abaddon](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/the-divide?locationIds=485302), near the corpse of Sunflower Summers, a fossilized dog named Seymour can be found. This is a reference to the tragic Futurama episode 'Jurassic Bark', where a dog of the same name meets a similar fate.

locations.title: Fist of the North Star Reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

The alternate name for the [Fist of Rawr](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/the-divide?locationIds=496140), 'Fist of the North Rawr', is a reference to the Fist of the North Star anime / manga.
